subject.title: memory_search: chokidar file watcher silently stops delivering events, index goes stale

question: Should memory_search accept a default periodic sync fallback for missed watcher events, or keep intervalMinutes defaulting to 0 and require a watcher-health/recovery-only fix?
rationale: The remaining fix is not only a code bug repair; changing the default interval affects background work, provider usage, and operator expectations for existing configs.

options.title: Repair and land periodic fallback
options.body: Use the linked PR direction after conflict repair and compatibility review, preserving intervalMinutes: 0 as the explicit opt-out.

options.title: Keep default 0 and fix watcher health
options.body: Reject the default change and require a narrower watcher liveness/restart path that does not add periodic work for existing default users.

options.title: Close the linked PR and keep issue canonical
options.body: Keep this issue open for a fresh maintainer-shaped implementation if the current PR is not the desired product direction.

recommendation.title: Repair and land periodic fallback
recommendation.body: Use the linked PR direction after conflict repair and compatibility review, preserving intervalMinutes: 0 as the explicit opt-out.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory index and stale-index safety work makes this the strongest available owner signal for the sync/freshness decision.
